chunks.subject: AP US History
chunks.title: SAQ exemplar — Q2 (Primary Source) Sample 2A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q2 (primary source: purpose behind promoting ideas such as Webster's) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). A describes one purpose of political leaders in promoting such ideas; B and C explain in-period events/developments as directed. Full credit — each part directly completes its describe/explain task with accurate, in-period evidence.

chunks.subject: AP US History
chunks.title: SAQ exemplar — Q2 Sample 2B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q2 scored 2/3 (A 1, B 1, C 0). Parts A and B earn credit; Part C does not — the response fails to explain how its evidence supports the prompt (or the evidence is off-topic/inaccurate). Reinforces that each part is scored independently and the third explain part is the most commonly missed.

chunks.subject: AP US History
chunks.title: SAQ exemplar — Q2 Sample 2C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q2 scored 1/3 (A 1, B 0, C 0). Only the describe part earns credit; both explain parts fail to establish an accurate, in-period how/why link. Typical of responses that describe the source adequately but cannot connect outside evidence to the argument.
